product_metadata.title: N&T NIETING 6FT Christmas Garland with Lights, 8 Light Modes Christmas Garland with 18 LED Lights Branches Berries Bells Snowflake Pinecones for Window Fireplace Door Stairs Indoor Outdoor Decoration
features: 🎄 [Realistic Christmas Garland] The garland christmas decor is total 6FT, equipped with artificial Christmas light strings, pine branches, 8 pinecones and 8 red berries, 8 red bells. We firmly bind these artificial decorations with copper wires. Additionally, pasting some Artificial snowflake on these Christmas decorations, make the outdoor Christmas decorations appear super lifelike.

🎄 [Pre-Lit Design] The Christmas decoration has 8 different lighting modes for you to choose. Just adjust the lighting modes by pressing the round button on the battery box to create a festive atmosphere at any time. The high brightness LED lamp string is powered by the battery(Not Include), which is durable and not generate heat, so that you can use Christmas garland with confidence.

🎄 [As a centerpiece for your Christmas dining table] Beautiful Christmas Garland are suitable for window frames, fireplaces, porches, doorways and other indoor and outdoor scenes, which can add warmth and joy to Christmas. It's also the best choice for Christmas gifts for your relatives and friends, could be pass your happiness to them.

🎄 [Foldable & Easy to store] There are flexible hard wires inside the Christmas Garland. You can bend it into any shape you want: heart shape/circle shape ect, Hanging it on the front door or other prominent position is particularly easy to attract the eyes of neighbors and bring you more unexpected fun. Moreover, the garland Christmas decorations is very portable and easy to store and place.

🎄 [Environment-Friendly Materials] Christmas garland are waterproof and high temperature resistant. Even when decorating outdoors, we do not have to worry about that the Christmas Garland got soaked in the rain and won't be able to work on. Lighted Christmas garland is also not easy to fade, so you can be applied year after year. And the tip has its own hanging ring for easy hanging.
